CardInfo.card_name: Axis Bank Vistara Signature Credit Card
CardInfo.fee_details:
- Joining Fee: Rs.1000 for primary card and Nil for add-on card.
- Annual Fee: Rs.2000 for primary card and Nil for add-on card.
CardInfo.joining_perks: As a part of the Welcome benefits, a new cardholder will receive a complimentary Premium Economy ticket. An air ticket will be offered during every instance of card renewal.
CardInfo.reward_structure:
- Every transaction using the credit card which is above Rs.2000 can get you cashback of 4 CV Points. These points are redeemable to purchase a range of products and services listed by the bank.
- During the first 3 months of membership, transactions amounting to Rs. 25,000 will earn 3000 CV Points. A complimentary Premium economy air ticket is awarded for transactions that exceed Rs. 50,000 (Rs.25,000+Rs.25,000) and Rs.1,00,000 (Rs.50,000+Rs.50,000).
CardInfo.key_highlights:
- A Vistara Signature Credit Card entitles a cardholder to a complimentary Club Vistara membership with benefits such as dedicated check-in and extra baggage allowance.
- One can receive up to a minimum 15% discount at restaurants which are in tie-up with Axis Bank Dining Delights.
- A cardholder can claim insurance exceeding up to Rs. 2,50,000 for Accident Cover and Lost and Liability up to 100% limit on the credit card.

benefits_features.Travel benefits: Complimentary Premium Economy air ticket is awarded for transactions that exceed Rs. 50,000 (Rs.25,000+Rs.25,000) and Rs.1,00,000 (Rs.50,000+Rs.50,000).
benefits_features.Fuel benefits: Surcharge on fuel-related payments is 1% of the total amount.
benefits_features.Dining benefits: One can receive up to a minimum 15% discount at restaurants which are in tie-up with Axis Bank Dining Delights.
benefits_features.Lounge benefits: Axis Bank offers exclusive access to airport lounges subject to the Vistara signature credit cardholders.
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: As a part of the Welcome benefits, a new cardholder will receive a complimentary Premium Economy ticket. An air ticket will be offered during every instance of card renewal.

how_tos.Redeem CV Points:
One can check their eligibility to redeem an Award Flight by visiting the website of Air Vistara and entering the required credentials.
Click on the Club Vistara option followed by the ‘Book a flight’ tab.
Choose the Redeem option and enter the necessary details on the Redeem Award Flight page.
Book the flight and contact the customer care service for further instructions or queries.

CardInfo.miscellaneous: Axis Bank is no longer accepting new applications for this credit card.

faqs.I have lost my Axis Bank Vistara Signatu: If you have lost your Axis Bank Vistara Signature Credit Card, you have to follow the following: Immediately inform Axis Bank. Immediately report the same at the police station near you. Get a copy of the First Information Report (FIR) for police verification and submit it to Axis Bank. If your card has been misused, the bank will take into account the transactions they provided coverage for equally under the policy terms and conditions.
faqs.How can I find further information about: To find further information about Axis Bank Vistara Signature Credit Card, you can check the bank’s website. You can also contact the Axis Bank Credit Card customer care department or visit the nearest branch of the bank to get the information.
